# PIM Manager

> Open-source (GPLv3) web app that shows who holds which Microsoft Entra ID admin role, and under which Privileged Identity Management (PIM) policy, and changes those policies and assignments in bulk: a dashboard, a report and a Configure page. It runs entirely in the browser and calls Microsoft Graph with the signed-in user's own token. There is no backend and no agent.

PIM Manager shows every directory role and PIM group with its assignments and policy side by side, which the Entra admin center shows one role at a time. Changes are reviewed first: the review runs checks and a validation-only dry run, an apply saves a snapshot, and the last ten applies can be undone.

## Who and what it shows holding roles

- Users, guests (accounts from another organisation), apps and managed identities (service principals), groups, and AI agents (Microsoft Entra Agent ID: agent identities, their user accounts and blueprints).
- Each assignment is labelled by type and shown as eligible, active (time-bound) or permanent, direct or through a group, tenant-wide or scoped to an administrative unit.

## Admin posture it points out

- Permanent Global Administrators, with marked emergency access accounts counted apart.
- Eligible assignments without an end date.
- Apps, AI agents and guests that hold roles.
- Roles that notify nobody, and roles that only have permanent assignments.
- Role-assignable groups outside PIM, whose members hold the role all the time.
- Activation terms per privileged role: MFA or authentication context, approval, justification, maximum duration.

## Coverage

- Directory roles (Entra roles): available. Built-in and custom roles, assignments and role policies.
- PIM for Groups: available. Member and owner assignments on PIM-onboarded groups.
- Role-assignable groups: available. Groups that can hold Entra roles but are not under PIM yet.
- Security alerts: available. Microsoft's PIM alerts with the accounts involved.
- Azure resource roles: in development, not available yet. Azure RBAC role eligibility and assignments on management groups, subscriptions, resource groups and resources, through Azure Resource Manager (a separate API from Microsoft Graph).

## Key facts

- Client-side only: tenant data, tokens and Graph responses stay in the user's browser session.
- Least privilege: sign-in asks for read permissions only; write permissions are requested per workload when the user chooses to grant them in Configure. An admin consents once per tenant.
- Hosted at https://pimmanager.com, or self-hosted on Azure Static Web Apps (free tier) with the user's own app registration.
- Live demo on a fictional tenant (Contoso), no sign-in and nothing sent to Microsoft: https://pimmanager.com/demo
- Author: Joël Prins.
